subject.title: refactor(zalouser): share offset-preserving text chunk ranges

question: Should chunkTextRanges, ChunkTextRangesOptions, and TextChunkRange become a supported public openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-chunking contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but an additive Plugin SDK API creates a lasting external compatibility commitment that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Accept the public SDK helper
options.body: Resolve the current conflict, refresh generated baselines, rerun the focused SDK and Zalouser proof, and merge the additive contract.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Share the implementation through an internal package boundary without exporting it to third-party plugins.

options.title: Retain the local implementation
options.body: Close the refactor if the maintenance reduction is not worth adding either a public or internal shared contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the public SDK helper
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflict, refresh generated baselines, rerun the focused SDK and Zalouser proof, and merge the additive contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned and marked maintainer-requested, and recent shared-runtime work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the SDK boundary decision.
